sql: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN pct_chg>0 THEN 1 END) AS 上涨家数, COUNT(CASE WHEN pct_chg<0 THEN 1 END) AS 下跌家数, COUNT(CASE WHEN pct_chg=0 THEN 1 END) AS 平盘家数, ROUND(AVG(pct_chg)::numeric, 2) AS 平均涨跌幅 FROM daily_kline WHERE trade_date=(SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM daily_kline)

SELECT 'stocks' AS 表名, COUNT(*) AS 数据量 FROM stocks UNION ALL SELECT 'daily_kline', COUNT(*) FROM daily_kline UNION ALL SELECT 'financial_reports', COUNT(*) FROM financial_reports UNION ALL SELECT 'etfs', COUNT(*) FROM etfs UNION ALL SELECT 'money_flow', COUNT(*) FROM money_flow UNION ALL SELECT 'industry_aggregation', COUNT(*) FROM industry_aggregation UNION ALL SELECT 'macro_data', COUNT(*) FROM macro_data UNION ALL SELECT 'stock_factors', COUNT(*) FROM stock_factors UNION ALL SELECT 'sentiment_data', COUNT(*) FROM sentiment_data ORDER BY 数据量 DESC

SELECT s.name AS 股票名称, d.ts_code AS 代码, d.close AS 收盘价, d.pct_chg AS 涨跌幅, d.amount AS 成交额 FROM daily_kline d JOIN stocks s ON d.ts_code=s.ts_code WHERE d.trade_date=(SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM daily_kline) ORDER BY d.amount DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT s.name AS 股票名称, d.ts_code AS 代码, d.close AS 收盘价, d.pct_chg AS 涨跌幅, d.amount AS 成交额 FROM daily_kline d JOIN stocks s ON d.ts_code=s.ts_code WHERE d.trade_date=(SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM daily_kline) ORDER BY d.pct_chg DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT s.name AS 股票名称, d.ts_code AS 代码, d.close AS 收盘价, d.pct_chg AS 涨跌幅, d.amount AS 成交额 FROM daily_kline d JOIN stocks s ON d.ts_code=s.ts_code WHERE d.trade_date=(SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM daily_kline) ORDER BY d.pct_chg ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT industry AS 行业, stock_count AS 股票数, avg_pct_chg AS 平均涨跌幅, up_count AS 上涨家数, down_count AS 下跌家数 FROM industry_aggregation WHERE trade_date=(SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM industry_aggregation) ORDER BY avg_pct_chg DESC

SELECT s.name AS 股票名称, m.ts_code AS 代码, m.main_net_inflow AS 主力净流入, m.super_large_net_inflow AS 超大单净流入, m.large_net_inflow AS 大单净流入 FROM money_flow m JOIN stocks s ON m.ts_code=s.ts_code WHERE m.trade_date=(SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM money_flow) ORDER BY m.main_net_inflow DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT MAX(trade_date) AS 最新交易日, MIN(trade_date) AS 最早交易日 FROM daily_kline
SELECT COUNT(*) AS 股票总数, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_active=true THEN 1 END) AS 活跃股票数 FROM stocks
SELECT industry AS 行业, COUNT(*) AS 股票数量 FROM stocks WHERE is_active=true GROUP BY industry ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
